test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the number and symbol series given below and answer the question that follows. Counting to be done from left to right only.

(NOTE: All numbers are single-digit numbers only.)

(Left) # 9 & 5 1 © * * * @ # & 7 & # $ 8 & 3 1 @ € (Right)

How many such symbols are there each of which is immediately preceded by a number and also immediately followed by a number?
solution:
**Given:** (Left) # 9 & 5 1 © * * * @ # & 7 & # $ 8 & 3 1 @ € (Right)

Now,

Symbols, each of which is immediately preceded by a number and also immediately followed by a number.

So, the needed pattern is: Number — Symbol — Number

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa290ab2e7b4fcf85489558f8d8624e6cbe5905392a840aeee32bfcb1ad1999e.png] 

Thus, there are 2 such symbols, each of which is immediately preceded by a number and also immediately followed by a number.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 1**".
